    To watch the Denver Nuggets game tonight, check if it's on Altitude Sports (local cable/streaming like Fubo, DirecTV Stream), national TV (NBC, ESPN, ABC), or Prime Video, or use NBA League Pass for out-of-market games, with local games also potentially on Altitude+ or through partners like 9News for over-the-air viewing. 
    For Local Fans (Colorado & Surrounding Areas):
    • Altitude Sports: Most games are broadcast here. You can get it via cable/satellite providers or streaming services like Fubo https://www.the (free trial available) or DirecTV Stream. 
    • Altitude+: A direct-to-subscriber streaming app for Altitude Sports. 
    • 9News: Some games are broadcast over-the-air via 9News. 
    For National Broadcasts:
    • Check if the game is on NBC, ESPN, ABC, or Prime Video, as selected games air here. 
    • Use your TV provider login on the NBA app or WatchESPN to stream these nationally televised games. 
    For Out-of-Market Fans: 
    • NBA League Pass: Stream all out-of-market games.
    Check Today's Specific Schedule: 
    • Visit the official Denver Nuggets How to Watch page or ESPN's schedule to confirm the exact channel and time for tonight's game.

      Is the NBA on NBC or Peacock?
      An AI Overview is not available for this searchCan't generate an AI overview right now. Try again later.
      AI Overview
      Yes, NBA games are on both NBC and Peacock for the 2025-2026 season, with NBC broadcasting select games on Sundays and Tuesdays, while Peacock streams exclusive Monday night games and simulcasts many of the NBC broadcasts, offering a comprehensive schedule of regular season and playoff action. You can catch big matchups on NBC's "Sunday Night Basketball" and "Coast 2 Coast Tuesday," with all these games also available live on Peacock. 
      This video explains the differences between Peacock and Paramount Plus for sports streaming:
      43s
      The Stream Guide
      YouTube · Feb 8, 2026
      Key Broadcast Details:
      • Peacock NBA Monday: Exclusive games streaming only on Peacock. 
      • Coast 2 Coast Tuesday: Doubleheaders on NBC and Peacock, with games often simulcast. 
      • Sunday Night Basketball: Primetime games on NBC and Peacock after the NFL season. 
      • Playoffs: NBC and Peacock will also have playoff coverage, including some conference finals. 
      How to Watch: 
      • Tune into your local NBC station for select games.
      • Stream all games live on the Peacock app or website.
